lessons_used: Helpful changes (won): Reordering sign-in after adoption, select new flows (desktop summon), targeted hints (photo upload, path decision, sign-in security), single-click and card carousel layouts, and desktop quick control redesign significantly improved metrics.

Harmful changes (worse): Specific copy changes (streamlined path selection, companion name certification), an account persistence hint, and the spotlight path selector layout significantly hurt performance.
No clear effect: Notifications, tutorial/showcase screens, wait time info/loading indicators, incentives, and several alternative copy, layout, and flow variations showed no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Large predicted gains were frequently overestimated across tests, including +15.0% (measured +7.0%) and +14.0% (no clear effect).

Predictions too low: Gains were underestimated for multiple winning tests, including home new flow (+1.0% vs +8.6%), sign-in security hint (-4.0% vs +3.1%), card carousel layout (+0.8% vs +5.3%), path helper hint (+0.5% vs +3.1%), and single-click layout (+2.8% vs +5.7%).

lessons_next: Helpful changes (won): Reordering sign-in after adoption, specific desktop flows (summon, visibility & control), targeted hints (photo upload, path decision, sign-in security), single-click and card carousel layouts, and desktop control redesigns consistently won.
Harmful changes (worse): Streamlined path copy, companion name certification copy, the account persistence hint, and the spotlight path selector layout significantly hurt performance.
No clear effect: Background notifications, tutorial/showcase screens, wait time/loading indicators, incentives, and various copy and layout variations showed no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Large predicted gains (e.g., +14.0% and +15.0%) were routinely overestimated, often leading to smaller actual gains or no clear effect.

Predictions too low: Major wins were significantly underestimated, most notably the desktop visibility onboarding flow (+4.5% predicted vs +16.6% measured), desktop summon flow (+1.0% vs +8.6%), and sign-in security hint (-4.0% vs +3.1%).
